 Item 1.01. Entry Into a Material Definitive Agreement 
 On November 3, 2026, 3M Company (“3M” or the “Company”) entered into a settlement arrangement (the “Settlement”) which is structured to promote participation by claimants and is intended to resolve the vast majority of alleged per- or poly-fluoroalkyl substance (“PFAS”)-related personal injury claims that are the focus of the Aqueous Film-Forming Foam multidistrict litigation (“AFFF MDL”) in federal district court in South Carolina. 
 Pursuant to the Settlement, reached through the mediation process that the Company has previously disclosed, 3M will contribute a total nominal amount of $7.35 billion between 2026 and 2034. The actual amount, payment terms, and dates are subject to satisfaction of certain participation thresholds claimants must meet. To participate in the settlement, individuals with actual or potential litigation claims in the AFFF MDL must enroll in the Settlement and provide 3M with a full release of any and all PFAS-related personal injury and certain other related claims they have asserted or could assert. 
 The Settlement provides that 3M does not admit any liability or wrongdoing. 
 The foregoing description of the Settlement is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the settlement agreement, a copy of which is filed as Exhibit 10.1 hereto and incorporated by reference herein. 
 Item 8.01 Other Events 
 On November 3, 2026, 3M issued a press release announcing the entry into the Settlement (filed as Exhibit 99.1 hereto and incorporated herein by reference). As a result of the Settlement, the Company will record a pre-tax charge of approximately $5.8 billion in the fourth quarter of 2026, representing the present value of contributions under the Settlement. This charge will be reflected as an adjustment in arriving at 3M’s results, adjusted for special items.
